title: Revisiting Simple Baselines for Relational Deep Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.20534v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relational deep learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning end-to-end predictive models over relational databases by representing them as temporal heterogeneous graphs. Recent advances based on graph neural networks and Transformers have achieved strong performance across diverse domains. However, the effectiveness of simpler relational baselines remains underexplored, making it difficult to assess how much architectural complexity is needed to achieve strong predictive performance. Motivated by the observation that predictive signals arise from target attributes, relational attributes, and historical labels, we revisit how effectively these signals can be exploited using simple propagation methods. We adapt fixed low-pass feature propagation to relational entity graphs and train an MLP for prediction. translated_title: 重新审视关系深度学习的简单基线方法
translated_abstract: 关系深度学习已成为一种强大的范式，它通过将关系数据库表示为时序异构图，从而在其上学习端到端的预测模型。基于图神经网络和Transformer的最新进展在多个不同领域取得了优异的性能。然而，更简单的关系基线方法的有效性仍未得到充分探索，这使得我们难以评估实现强大预测性能究竟需要多复杂的架构。受“预测信号来源于目标属性、关系属性和历史标签”这一观察的启发，我们重新审视了如何使用简单的传播方法来有效利用这些信号。我们将固定的低通特征传播方法适配到关系实体图上，并训练一个多层感知机（MLP）进行预测。所得的预测结果进一步通过Correct-and-Smooth（一种基于图的标签传播算法）进行优化改进……
tldr: 本文提出了一种简单但有效的关系深度学习基线方法，通过将低通特征传播应用于关系实体图并训练MLP，再结合Correct-and-Smooth标签传播算法优化预测结果，证明无需复杂的图神经网络架构即可实现强大的预测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a simple yet effective baseline for relational deep learning by applying low-pass feature propagation to relational entity graphs with an MLP predictor, further refined by Correct-and-Smooth label propagation, demonstrating that strong predictive performance can be achieved without complex graph neural network architectures.
